$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-messagebird-sms-source). Seeds the pre-built `messagebird-sms` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (MessageDispatchProvider) and, transitively, pipelinq's MessageBirdSmsClient. MessageBird (Bird) REST API authenticates with an `Authorization: AccessKey {key}` request header. Ships dormant (isEnabled:false) with the real MessageBird REST base URL and auth:apikey so a fresh install resolves the endpoint without carrying a secret. Operators paste their MessageBird access key onto `configuration.headers.Authorization` (replacing the empty AccessKey placeholder) and flip isEnabled via the OpenConnector Sources UI. The base URL is admin-owned on the source (no SSRF surface). OUTBOUND (side-effecting POST /messages) — provider selection / STOP opt-out / dedupe / delivery-status reconciliation stay in the consuming app (pipelinq SmsAdapter).

objects.name: MessageBird SMS
objects.description: MessageBird (Bird) REST API (SMS). Consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (POST a single SMS). Dormant placeholder — the base URL is the production MessageBird REST endpoint; set your access key on `configuration.headers.Authorization` as `AccessKey {your-key}` and enable. Send path is `messages` (POST /messages).
